center_darkness_diagnostic.method: 48x48 center mean minus mean of four 48x48 windows offset by 72 pixels
center_darkness_diagnostic.interpretation: a negative value indicates a darker center than its local neighbors

visual_finding: No obvious regular Vickers diamond indent was seen in the 81 darkest-center candidates; reviewed dark regions were consistent with microstructural contrast, boundaries, scratches, or defects.
limitation: This screen does not prove indent absence and does not validate the approximate optical-to-hardness transform.
